critical_code_review_comments: social.py:411 generate_negative_theme_tasks() inserts (theme × manager) tasks but enforces idempotency only at the per-week run level via social_auto_runs. There is no compound unique index on customer_tasks for (auto_generated, auto_week_start, auto_theme, assignee_user_id), so if social_auto_runs is ever wiped/edited manually, a re-run would silently duplicate tasks. Recommend adding a guarded insert (find_one before insert_one or a unique index) for defense-in-depth.

maybe_run_weekly() is called only on backend startup and only fires if today is Monday. If the backend stays up across the week, the Monday hook never fires after the initial Monday boot, and on Tuesday-Sunday boots it's a no-op — the manual /run is the only fallback. A real cron/APScheduler 'every Monday 08:00 UTC' would be more reliable.

Auto-task notes hardcode the inbox link path '/inbox (filter sentiment=negative, theme={theme})' but the inbox UI doesn't yet accept theme as a query param — the deep-link is informational only; consider wiring the filter param into Inbox.jsx so the manager can one-click jump.
/auto-tasks/kpi computes median_resolution_hours over 60 days but completed_14d uses 14 days — slightly inconsistent windows. Document or unify.

ManagerDashboard.jsx line 294 runAutoTasks awaits api.post then refetches; there is no optimistic disabled state on the per-task 'Mark resolved' buttons, so a user can double-click and fire two POSTs (only one succeeds, but it's ugly). Disable individual row buttons during refresh.
